name: Digent Appointments
author: amanstacker

sections.description:
Digent Appointments is a powerful and user-friendly appointment booking plugin for WordPress designed for businesses, agencies, consultants, clinics, salons, and service providers.

The plugin allows you to create services, assign staff, configure schedules, and let customers book appointments directly from your website.

Whether you are running a small business or managing multiple staff members, Digent Appointments provides a flexible scheduling system to simplify your booking workflow.

Features

  • Easy appointment booking system
  • Staff and employee management
  • Services and categories support
  • Flexible schedules and working hours
  • Booking calendar management
  • Customer appointment form
  • Email notifications
  • Appointment status management
  • Responsive booking interface
  • Shortcode support
  • Translation ready
  • Developer friendly structure

Perfect For

  • Salons
  • Clinics
  • Consultants
  • Agencies
  • Coaches
  • Tutors
  • Freelancers
  • Repair services
  • Fitness trainers
  • Local businesses

Developer Friendly

Digent Appointments follows WordPress coding standards and is built with extensibility in mind for developers and agencies.

Documentation

Documentation will be available soon.

Credits

Digent Appointments uses the following third-party libraries:

  1. FullCalendar – A JavaScript library for showing calendar data

    • Link: https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar
    • License: MIT

  2. Select2 – A JavaScript library to make select type more advanced

    • Link: https://github.com/select2/select2
    • License: MIT

  3. Flatpickr – Lightweight, powerful javascript datetimepicker with no dependencies

    • Link: https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr
    • License: MIT
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/digent-appointments directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Digent Appointments from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your services, staff, and schedules.
  5. Add the booking shortcode to any page.
sections.faq:
Is Digent Appointments free?

Yes, the core plugin is free to use.

Does it support multiple staff members?

Yes, you can manage multiple staff members and assign services to them.

Can customers book appointments online?

Yes, customers can book appointments directly from your website.

Is the plugin mobile friendly?

Yes, the booking interface is responsive and works on mobile devices.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes, the plugin is translation ready.
